message: The other day, I was chatting with my granddaughter about how we would handle things if the power went out. Just as I reached for my phone to show her some fun ideas, the battery died! 😅 We had a good laugh, but it reminded me how important it is to have a plan that doesn’t rely on technology. It’s those little moments that inspire me to keep our go-bags ready and to have a few essentials stashed away. What’s one thing you always keep on hand for those unexpected times?
